title: One Out From Perfect
setup: June 2, 2010. Detroit's Armando Galarraga is one out from a perfect game against Cleveland. Jason Donald hits the ball toward first, and first-base umpire Jim Joyce calls him safe. Joyce later admits he got the call wrong, and he apologizes to Galarraga and hugs him after the game.
question: What does Commissioner Bud Selig do about the call?
options: Reverses it and credits Galarraga with a perfect game.
ruling: Selig would not reverse the call. He said MLB would look at expanded video replay and umpiring. Detroit won 3-0.
rulebookNote: Detroit's general manager, Dave Dombrowski, said the team would not ask MLB to overturn the call.
